unit.pair_row: M8: y in [8.64m - 4.32, 8.64m + 4.32] (VSS stripe at 8.64m, VDD stripes at the edges)
unit.shields: near = the VSS stripe (flank); far = drawn 0.64 VSS at VSS +-2.3, VIA89-tied to the crossing VSS grid
unit.pin_window: cells of a class put their pin row within 2.5 um of their trunk (VIA78 riser) or reach an M9 track by an M8 jog <= 8.64 um

rules: A pair-row/pair-col reserved for a class over an x (y) span carries only that class's trunks, jogs, escapes and drawn shields over that span; no other class's M8/M9 shape and no other class's M8-access pin window (+-2.5 um of a track) inside it.
LOCAL (strip-local bisection, core feeds, reset, anything else on M8/M9) uses every other pair-row/pair-col; its column-band M8 jogs avoid the reserved node rows.
Column-chain repeaters sit at any y in the legal column except the TOP rows 1519..1525 and the node/leg rows; their in/out jogs are on opposite sides of the pin row (vertical chains need no escape).
Horizontal repeaters (TOP, legs): flow-oriented (MY for -x flow) or the row's second track as escape.
No PG stripe is cut, moved or narrowed (the plan die.pg.grid is unchanged).

node_rows.note: A drop jog + Y jog of one bisection node

leg_rows.demand: 1 trunk + the L4 node A jog inside the column band; flow-oriented (MY) repeaters or repeaters outside the column band keep the escape track free
